spans.s:
r. 1st cl. (घोरति)
To go as a horse.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Frightful, horrible, terrific.
m. (-रः)
A name of ŚIVA.
f. (-रा)
Night.
n. (-रं)
Horror, horribleness.
2 Poison.
E.
घुर to be frightful, affix अच्; or घुर substituted for हन to injure or kill, and अच् Uṇādi aff.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Terrific, of horrid or frightful appearance.
m. (-नः)
An owl.
E.
घोर as above, and दर्शन sight.

n. (-ष्पः)
Bellmetal.
E.
घोर, and पुष्प a flower.

m. (-नः)
A jackall.
E.
घोर frightful, and रासन cry or sound, from रास to sound, affix ल्युट्.

m. (-सी)
A jackall.
E.
see the last, णिनि aff.

mfn. (-पः-पी-पं)
Frightful, hideous.
n. (-पं)
A hideous appearance.
E.
घोर, and रूप form.

mfn. (-पी-पिणी-पि)
Frightful, horrible, hideous.
E.
घोररूप, and इनि aff.

mfn. (-शः-शा-शं)
Dreadful, horrible.
E.
घोर, and सङ्काश like.

mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति)
Frightful, hideous, of horrible aspect or form.
E.
घोर, and आकृति form.
